title: Meep runtime benchmarks for Nyquist-sampled time-domain adjoint FDTD
description: Controlled computational benchmark characterizing source duration, forward DFT-monitor overhead, and adjoint runtime at a fixed design configuration. Includes simulation code, archived data, repeated timing comparisons, and supporting diagnostics. Full device-optimization workflows are outside the scope of this archive.
